authentication: Bearer API key from native OS credential store or OPENAI_API_KEY; BFT_TOKEN only in opt-in development tests

capabilities.input: Selected Evidence text/OCR and original-page provenance; no PDF, image, filesystem or network tools
capabilities.output: Unreviewed package, translation, explanation and trusted-registry IR value candidates
capabilities.limitations: Drawing and land-pattern tasks interpret supplied text/OCR only; no image-only interpretation. Confidence does not prove correctness. Human review and deterministic validation remain mandatory.

data_handling.provider_terms: OpenAI account retention/abuse monitoring terms apply; store=false does not guarantee zero retention
data_handling.local_mode: No outbound request; AI interpretation unavailable
